about: Windows of bars with the g1 code each has when dimensions are switched on. Shared by Vaquum/Filang (the study engine and the Rust core) and Vaquum/Composer: all must read every window here to the same code.
rule: The price part is the g1 code of the window, as recorded or as a chain, and does not depend on the dimensions. Each dimension has one value per bar: volume = v; trades = n; delta = 2*b - v; size = v / n, absent when n is 0; imbalance = (2*b - v) / v, absent when v is 0, where v is the USDT traded, b the taker-buy USDT and n the trade count. A value is the 64-bit float the expression gives when evaluated as written. A dimension part ranks the bars' values, equal values sharing a rank; delta and imbalance rank zero with them and write its rank after a slash. A window's code for any set of dimensions is the price part followed by "|" and each chosen part, in the order volume, trades, delta, size, imbalance. A part of null means a bar has no such value, and the window then has no code for any set that includes that dimension.
units: Each bar is [open, high, low, close, volume, taker_buy_volume, trade_count]: prices in integer cents as recorded, volume and taker-buy volume in USDT, trades as a count.
